agents.name: reference-solution
agents.description: Deterministic known-good agent. Applies the bundled reference solutions for the textkit benchmark. Not a model: it exists to prove the pipeline can award SOLVED when a correct patch is produced, and to anchor comparisons.

agents.name: partial-solution
agents.description: Solves only the slugify task and leaves the other two untouched. Produces a mix of SOLVED and UNSOLVED outcomes, which is what makes comparison and failure-analysis screens meaningful without a model.

agents.name: regression-introducing
agents.description: Makes the truncate acceptance tests pass while breaking a pre-existing test. Demonstrates that the pass_to_pass grading layer actually catches regressions.

agents.name: no-op
agents.description: Changes nothing. Every task is graded UNSOLVED with failure category no_patch_produced.

agents.name: test-tamperer
agents.description: Attempts to pass by overwriting the graded test file. Demonstrates the forbidden-path guard: the patch layer fails before any test runs.
